newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bearish tone likely to continue in Dhaka stocks.
newsitem.headline: Bearish tone likely to continue in Dhaka stocks.

text.p: The Dhaka stock exchange was likely to remain in a bearish mood on Monday on negative corporate results, brokers said.
The market was depressed by news on Sunday that two leading companies, Apex Footwear and Dynamic Textile, would not be able to offer dividends for the year 1996/97.

"Already the market was hungry for positive news. Such announcements cause further frustration among investors," said broker Sabbir Ahmed. Textile and leather scrips might fall, he said. The Dhaka Stock Exchange all- share price index dropped 23.79 points or 2.46 percent to 899.98 on Sunday. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-869749
